title: Chapter Roll Overrides
description: Hand-curated (or, from Phase 4 onward, agent-curated) per-chapter paid roll structure and evidence metadata. Consolidated read/validation gate for data/manual/chapter_roll_overrides.json — see scripts/chapter_roll_overrides_io.py. `curated_by` is required on every chapter entry and never defaults (D-01): an absent value is a validation error, not a silent human-assumption.
